title: Outreach to Akropong School for the Blind
venue: Akropong School for the Blind, Akropong, Eastern Region
summary: Our Evangelism Ministry visits the Akropong School for the Blind to share the love of Christ. Volunteers and donations welcome.
description: Join the Evangelism Ministry as we visit the Akropong School for the Blind to share the gospel, pray with the students and staff, and give practical support.
To volunteer or donate, please contact the church office or give through the Give page, using Evangelism as your reference.

title: Thanksgiving Service
summary: A special service of praise and thanksgiving for all God has done this year.
description: Come and join us as we lift our voices in gratitude to God for His faithfulness throughout the year.
Bring your family and friends, and come ready to dance and give thanks.

title: Youth Conference
summary: A day of worship, teaching and fellowship for young people.
description: Young people from across Tema and beyond are invited to a day of powerful worship, practical teaching and fun fellowship.
Admission is free. Invite a friend.

title: Christmas Carols Night
summary: Celebrate the birth of Jesus with carols, readings and joy.
description: An evening of carols, scripture readings and celebration as we remember the birth of our Saviour.

title: Go Ye Train: Akuse Prisons Outreach
summary: Our annual outreach to Akuse Prisons. Volunteers and donations welcome.
description: The Go Ye Train returns to Akuse Prisons for the fifth year. We will share the gospel, pray with inmates and donate food, toiletries and clothing.
To volunteer or donate, please contact the church office or give through the Give page, using Evangelism as your reference.
